newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit consolidates gains despite mild dlr buying.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit consolidates gains despite mild dlr buying.

text.p: The ringgit consolidated recent gains and was expected to trade in a range despite mild dollar buying, dealers said on Wednesday.
"There seems to have been some (dollar) buying out of Australia a little while ago. But it has been absorbed by the market," said an assistant chief dealer with a European bank in Singapore.
"Dollar/ringgit is going to remain here for a while. I am bearish on the dollar," he said.
Dealers said buying had also resumed in ringgit/Sing after Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad's statement on Tuesday that he did not want the ringgit to weaken.
Mahathir told reporters at an energy conference that he didn't "see the need to lower the ringgit".
